changelog: A programme's bar can no longer be resized, because its length was never yours to set. The plugin plays an episode or a film for as long as the file runs and ignores whatever length the stored week carries, so dragging the bottom of one never made it shorter - it changed how much room the programme was given, and if that room came out under the runtime the programme silently did not play at all. Dragging to move it is unchanged, and the tooltip now says where the length comes from. An address dropped onto the week still resizes, because there its stored length really is the one that is used.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
